name: PSX Ascend
summary: A connected powersports dealership growth platform (CRM, inventory, websites, marketing automation, multi-location BDC). Forest and paper structure with green for action, Geist type, the original logo file only. Imported from the approved v2.0 design system; rules from the unapproved v3 candidate and social toolkit are marked proposed.

ownership.note: A client brand managed by the agency owner. Served only to the owner's tenant (BRANDS_OWNER_TENANT_ID).

approvers: Rana Zain Usman (owner, sends the review)
approval.rule: Anything made with this brand that will be published (a post, ad, email, page or graphic) goes to Jeff, Dan and Rick for review by email from rana@psxascend.ai before it goes live. Changes to this design system itself follow the same review. Nothing is sent or published automatically.

scale.sample: One customer view across every rooftop
Help dealership teams recognize customer intent and respond with context.
Review the conversation, confirm the owner and the next step, then follow up.

rules: Exactly one H1 and a logical H2/H3 order. Negative tracking for large headings only.
Body at least 16px; meaningful UI copy at least 12px; body lines about 55-75 characters.
No heavy bold headings across body sections. Hero/display weight 680, editorial headings 400, card titles 500.
Mobile headings wrap naturally: no clipping, no one-word columns, no manual breaks for one desktop width.
8px rhythm: micro 4/8/12, component 16/20/24/32, content 40/48/56/64, sections 78-120, hero padding 88-110px.
Whitespace clarifies hierarchy; it must not separate eyebrows from headings or make cards feel empty.

layout.grid: Grid for page structure, Flexbox for compact alignment. Standard split about 1.1fr / .55fr; card grids go 4 or 3, then 2, then 1.
rules: Product heroes pair copy with a meaningful interface or image.
Never remove, crop or hide meaningful dashboard content on mobile; stack it.
No horizontal page scrolling at any tested width (360-1440px).

files.name: PSX Ascend horizontal logo (original)
files.use: The only logo. Site header and footer, and every graphic, email and post. On dark or busy backgrounds, place it on a warm-white (Paper) field.

logo.clearSpace: Candidate rule: at least the capital-letter height of the wordmark on every side.

minSize.note: Candidate: 154 CSS px wide on screen; at least 240px wide on a 1080px social export, reviewed at feed size; 32mm in print.

do: Use only this original file, or write 'PSX Ascend' in plain text.
Preserve its ratio, colours and clear space.
On dark or photo backgrounds, put the full-colour logo on a Paper field.
Image alt text 'PSX Ascend'; a linked logo's accessible name 'PSX Ascend home'.
dont: Never draw, typeset or AI-generate a 'PSX ASCEND' wordmark, and never set 'PSX' and 'ASCEND' in two colours.
Never reuse the archived old og.png wordmark.
Never stretch, crop, rotate, recolour, outline, shadow or remove part of the name.
Never extract an icon or avatar from the lockup; no approved symbol master exists.
Never fuse a partner or OEM mark with it, place it on conflicting green, or crowd it with a CTA.
logo.licence: PSX Ascend's trademark, used by the agency for PSX Ascend work only. Only the horizontal raster exists: vector, reversed, stacked, symbol and monochrome masters are missing, and a missing variant is not permission to make one.

imagery.style: Powersports showrooms, machines, dealership teams, customer conversations, deliveries and inventory workflows, with faces and vehicles kept in every crop. Product views show real operating context with labelled demo data.
do: Use images that add context, evidence or understanding.
WebP/AVIF, descriptive file names, explicit dimensions, accurate alt text.
Caption illustrative or generated imagery when it could be mistaken for evidence.
Label demonstration data as such; attribute real results as dealer-reported.
dont: No generic corporate stock or generic SaaS dashboards.
Existing images are references, not proof of named people or events.
No neon gradients, arbitrary blues or purples, or a feed that turns neon green.

icons.style: One existing licensed icon family with a consistent stroke and size.
rules: Icons accompany text for meaningful controls; never replace a label with an unexplained icon.
Decorative arrows are hidden from assistive technology. Up-right arrow means navigate or act; down-right means continue on the page.
Never draw new product logos; OEM and dealer marks are proof, shown as original artwork with accurate names.
Lead with the dealership problem, decision or outcome. Concrete nouns: customer, salesperson, unit, inventory, rooftop, conversation, appointment, next action.
Explain AI through useful dealership behaviour, with people and manager control visible.
Approved names only: PSX Ascend; CXMAi; ALMA, the Automated Lead Management Assistant; AI-Powered CRM; Inventory Management; AI-Powered Websites; Marketing Automation; Multi-Location BDC.
Never invent metrics, results, integrations, awards, quotes or capabilities. Label customer results as dealer-reported and keep verified wording.
No em dashes in headings, decorative hashes, vague hype or generic AI language.
Copy sequence: eyebrow, direct heading, practical description, action, then proof or operating context.
Stable action language: Request a demo, Visit support, Continue to secure login. US English.

examples.say: Help dealership teams recognize customer intent and respond with context.
examples.avoid: Revolutionary AI that transforms your dealership overnight.
The number one AI platform for every dealer.

rules: One main point per creative; the caption carries the detail.
At 1080px wide: headline 76-104px, body 34-44px, essential metadata at least 28px; check at about one-third size.
The logo sits in a predictable place with clear space; on dark or photo backgrounds it goes on a Paper field.
Green for one word, one rule or one small area of emphasis only.
A drawn CTA on a static image is not a button: the caption and destination complete the action.
Proof, events, hiring and partner posts only with verified source material; never fictional details.
Meta placement specs are not certified in the source: preview every feed, story and reel placement before release.
Every PSX creative goes to Jeff, Dan and Rick for review before it is published.

rules: Lift at most 2px; the arrow shifts gently up-right.
Focus: 3px solid #96ED7C with 3px offset.
Adjacent mobile buttons become full width with visible spacing.

rules: One primary intent per page.

components.name: Light outline on dark
components.label: Continue to secure login
components.spec: Transparent, light outline, White text, pill: secondary action on dark.
rules: Never put two adjacent dark CTAs together.

components.name: Premium hover card
components.label: One customer view
components.spec: White card, Line border, 18px radius; on hover lifts 5-7px over 720ms with a soft forest shadow.
rules: Every card has a purpose, a name, a concise description and a meaningful visual or state.
Hover never moves neighbouring layout or hides content.

components.name: Light badge
components.label: Dealer-reported

rules: Green never communicates success alone: add the word.

components.name: Form field
components.label: Dealership email
components.spec: Visible label, 16px input, Muted boundary (not the faint Line).
rules: Required state programmatic; clear errors; privacy context near submit.
Never capture or imitate platform passwords in marketing pages.

components.name: Inline link
components.label: See how ALMA works
rules: Green text only on dark surfaces.
Reveal about 720ms, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), stagger 60-90ms; card lift 5-7px; button lift at most 2px.
Gentle breathing only for live statuses and popup cards; animate transform and opacity.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; all content visible without animation; pause continuous work off-screen.
